scenes.scene_description: Storm clouds swirl above Mount Kailash as the camera descends toward its silent, snow-covered peaks.
scenes.background: Storm-churned sky and majestic Himalayan mountains
scenes.action: Wind howls, setting a dramatic tone for the divine setting

scenes.scene_description: Shiva sits in deep stillness atop the peak, glowing faintly against the twilight.
scenes.action: Shiva remains motionless, radiating a subtle divine light

scenes.scene_description: Shiva’s matted locks blow in the wind, revealing the crescent moon and trickling Ganga.
scenes.action: Hair unravels, moon cradled in strands, Ganga flows gently

scenes.scene_description: The cosmos seems to breathe around him, alive with celestial energy.
scenes.background: Star-streaked night sky with rippling cosmic patterns
scenes.action: The stars shimmer and pulse in rhythm with Shiva’s presence

scenes.scene_description: Tigers are seen prowling calmly in the distance, watching the divine scene.
scenes.background: Mountain slopes with sparse forest and snow
scenes.action: Tigers walk in silence, heads low, respectful observers

scenes.scene_description: Serpents loosely coil around Shiva’s throat, resting without tension.
scenes.action: Serpents shift gently with his breath, at peace

scenes.scene_description: Shiva breathes deeply, sending vibrations through the fabric of creation.
scenes.action: Stars scatter and pulse with each breath

scenes.scene_description: His eyes open slowly, and the third eye blazes to life like a sun.
scenes.action: A radiant flash erupts from his forehead, shaking space and time

scenes.scene_description: Time around him begins to dissolve into silence and light.
scenes.background: Time-lapse of creation folding into stillness
scenes.action: Moments and memories blend into a golden aura

scenes.scene_description: Shiva picks up his damaru, its first beat echoing like thunder across dimensions.
scenes.action: He raises the drum and strikes it, starting the universal rhythm

scenes.scene_description: He rises and begins the cosmic dance of destruction and rebirth.
scenes.background: Flames and galaxies spiral in unison
scenes.action: Each movement of his dance reshapes the universe

scenes.scene_description: In the heart of this chaos, Shiva remains the unmoving eye of eternity.
scenes.background: Exploding galaxies encircling a still divine figure
scenes.action: While the cosmos churns, Shiva stands in perfect stillness
